checkpoint_review: The Router was generally accurate but slightly lenient on the 'QWERTY/Nav Pad' checkpoint. The taxonomy explicitly requires a QWERTY keyboard or navigation pad. The image shows only two large oval buttons and a small circle, which resembles a media player or simple game console more than a 'hand-held computer' as defined. However, since the Fine-Grained Classifier confirmed the class label with high confidence (Rank 1), I will accept this as a valid variation of the class rather than a failure. The Router correctly marked weight and battery status as untestable.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified text gibberish on the bezel (Severity 2.5). The Image Text Auditor confirmed this by returning empty blocks, indicating total illegibility. The Router noted 'structural collapse' at buttons (Severity 1.0); I agree this is minor edge softness. The Perceptual Quality Auditor flagged 'compression' artifacts (Severity 0.4 equivalent to ~1.5-2.0 on our scale due to pixelation/blockiness). The screen content blur noted by the Router is consistent with AI-generated UI textures. The most significant artifact is the nonsensical logo, which breaks realism.
alignment_reasoning: The image aligns well with the general form factor of a handheld device. The Fine-Grained Classifier strongly supports the 'hand-held computer' label (Logit 5.67 vs 5.12 for cassette player). While the specific control layout (buttons vs QWERTY) deviates from the strict taxonomy description, it is functionally plausible for the class. 6/9 checkpoints were testable and passed; 3 were untestable. The deviation in controls prevents a perfect score.
artifact_reasoning: Primary defect is the illegible/gibberish text on the top bezel, a classic AI artifact. Secondary issues include low-resolution/compression-like blockiness (confirmed by PQ Auditor) and slight softness/blurring in the screen UI and button edges. These artifacts reduce the photorealism significantly compared to a clean product shot, but do not constitute structural failure.
key_defects: Illegible/gibberish brand logo on top bezel
